articles.title: Charlotte Flair surprises with a confession that could change her WWE story
articles.standfirst: The wrestler, known for her strong personality and historic career, acknowledged that there is one type of storyline she has yet to explore.
articles.summary: The wrestler, known for her strong personality and historic career, acknowledged that there is one type of storyline she has yet to explore.
articles.body:
Charlotte Flair has made it clear that she is not someone who goes unnoticed in WWE . Her strong character, personality in the ring and career filled with major accomplishments have made her one of the company’s most recognizable stars. However, despite all these years in the spotlight, there is one element that has yet to become part of her story inside the ring and, as she herself admits, it is something that sparks her curiosity.

During her appearance on The Power Hour, Charlotte Flair was asked about the possibility of one day being involved in a romantic storyline in WWE. In response, the wrestler left the door open to the idea that something like that could happen.

However, the idea did not come out of nowhere. Charlotte had already addressed the subject during her appearance at Fanatics Fest NYC .

On that occasion, she explained that she had never been involved in a romantic storyline in WWE or been paired with a male character.

A career built on major storylines

The possibility becomes even more intriguing when considering everything Charlotte has built in WWE. At 40 years old, the wrestler has won 14 world championships during her career on the main roster and has spent much of her time involved in some of the biggest rivalries in the women’s division .

Her character has also been defined by a strong personality and confidence that are essential parts of The Queen . For that reason, a romantic storyline would take her into territory she has rarely explored in front of the WWE audience.

And that is precisely what makes the idea so interesting: Charlotte is not talking about repeating a rivalry, chasing another championship or entering another major match . She is talking about showing a side of her character that has barely ever been part of the conversation.

But could it actually happen?

For now, there is no confirmed romantic storyline for Charlotte, and there is no information indicating that WWE is preparing something along those lines. Her comments simply show that she is open to the possibility if a storyline comes along that makes sense for her character.

articles.title: Dwayne Johnson slips up by revealing his return to WWE amid film-related conflicts
articles.standfirst: The Rock hints at another WrestleMania appearance despite a packed Hollywood schedule
articles.summary: The Rock hints at another WrestleMania appearance despite a packed Hollywood schedule
articles.body:
Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson may have accidentally revealed that another WrestleMania appearance is somewhere in his future.

While the Hollywood superstar didn’t provide a date or indicate whether he plans to wrestle, his recent comments strongly suggest that WWE fans haven’t seen the last of him at its biggest annual event.

Johnson made a surprise appearance on The Morning Shift while the hosts were discussing “Your Dad,” a song associated with his upcoming Moana project.

The conversation eventually moved toward his legendary WWE career when one of the hosts admitted that seeing The Rock make his famous WrestleMania entrance in person remained on his bucket list.

The response from Johnson was enough to get wrestling fans talking.

Johnson made a promise that he’d be invited whenever The Rock eventually returns to WrestleMania. His choice of words was particularly interesting because he didn't say “if” he goes back. Instead, he spoke about it as something that would happen at some point.

“I’ll make the promise to you now, whenever I do go back to WrestleMania, I gotta have you guys out,” Johnson said, promising that the hosts would be his special guests.

The comment comes after a lengthy absence from WWE television. Johnson's most recent appearance was at Elimination Chamber 2025, where he played a pivotal role in John Cena's shocking heel turn and further established his “Final Boss” persona.

His last match, meanwhile, took place at WrestleMania 40. The Rock teamed with Roman Reigns against Cody Rhodes and Seth Rollins in one of the event's most heavily discussed encounters.

Hollywood commitments could complicate The Rock’s WWE return

Although Johnson's comments have sparked speculation, they don't confirm that he’ll appear at WrestleMania 43. The 2027 event is scheduled to take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, marking the first time WrestleMania will be held outside North America.

One major obstacle could be Johnson's increasingly busy Hollywood schedule. He’s expected to return as Luke Hobbs in Fast Forever, the planned final mainline installment of the Fast & Furious franchise.

Production is expected to begin in December 2026, with the movie currently scheduled for release in March 2028.

That could create a significant scheduling challenge if WWE hopes to bring Johnson back for a match. An in-ring comeback, particularly one involving a major WrestleMania storyline, would require substantial physical preparation and training.

Johnson had previously appeared to be part of the direction surrounding Cody Rhodes and John Cena , but he ultimately didn't participate in their WrestleMania 41 championship showdown.

There’s no confirmed opponent, storyline or date for The Rock's next WWE appearance. Still, his promise suggests that another WrestleMania entrance could eventually become reality.

The only question is whether his movie commitments will determine when fans finally see The Final Boss step through the ropes again.

articles.title: The hidden gem of NXT Heatwave: Why Kelani Jordan's brutal match is “One of the best of the year”
articles.standfirst: With an almost perfect rating from a 23-minute battle, the new champion was crowned in Texas.
articles.summary: With an almost perfect rating from a 23-minute battle, the new champion was crowned in Texas.
articles.body:
"The world of professional wrestling woke up today with only one topic of conversation: what happened at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas during the NXT Heatwave event has gone beyond the screen.

The match for the NXT Women’s Championship was between Kelani Jordan , famous for her past as a high-level collegiate artistic gymnast, and thanks to this discipline she has a unique wrestling style, and on the other side Kendal Grey , a true legend of college sports in the United States, a three-time amateur Olympic wrestling champion.

The reasons that make this fight the most viral match of the year.

The contest, which stretched for nearly 23 minutes, saw an inspired Kelani Jordan crowned after defeating Kendal Grey in a true display of endurance and aerial agility. Jordan, who already had the NXT Women's North American Championship and the TNA Knockouts title on her résumé, finally reached the top of her division after three and a half years of relentless pursuit.

Beyond the historic result and the emotional celebration, what has set digital platforms ablaze is the sheer brutality and the extremely high physical level with which both competitors pushed their rivalry to the limit. The audience described the competitors as two "kindred spirits of the ring" because of the fluidity they maintained. According to Jordan, both are perfectionists, highly competitive, and came into the showdown determined to give their all, which produced a highly intense match from start to finish.

The spectacular nature of the clash reached its peak when Grey executed an impressive reverse Spanish Fly from the top rope that left everyone in shock. Despite the devastating impact, Jordan’s resilience in kicking out at the count of three became the narrative engine that ultimately enshrined the match in the eyes of the audience.

The specialized press has not held back in its praise, unanimously backing the popular outcry. The main news outlets have described the matchup as " fantastic", applauding the magnificent contrast between Jordan's gymnastics background and Grey's Olympic wrestling base.

The title has a special meaning for Jordan . She stated that she had been chasing it for three and a half years and that, although she had already won other championships —including the NXT Women"s North American Championship and the TNA Knockouts Championship—, this one represented the pinnacle of NXT’s women’s division.

articles.title: Andy Williams cause of death: 'The Butcher' dies at 48 during a match
articles.standfirst: Tributes have poured in for the popular wrestler and musician following his sudden death at age 48
articles.summary: Tributes have poured in for the popular wrestler and musician following his sudden death at age 48
articles.body:
Andy “The Butcher” Williams , the professional wrestler and former Every Time I Die guitarist, has died at the age of 48 after suffering a medical emergency during a match in Pennsylvania.

Williams collapsed near the conclusion of an Enjoy Wrestling event at Mr. Smalls Theatre in Millvale on Saturday night. He was teaming with his longtime partner Jesse Guilmette , better known as The Blade, against TME when he suddenly went down.

Medical personnel rushed to Williams ’ aid and began performing CPR. An automated external defibrillator was also used before an ambulance arrived and took him to hospital. The remainder of the wrestling event was canceled, with organizers sending attendees home.

The Allegheny County Medical Examiner’s Office confirmed Williams ’ death. However, his official cause of death hasn’t been announced, and authorities haven’t provided further details about the medical emergency.

Enjoy Wrestling later confirmed the tragic news, prompting an outpouring of tributes from across the wrestling and music communities. Numerous performers and colleagues remembered Williams online, highlighting the impact he had made during a career that crossed two very different forms of entertainment.

A career across wrestling and heavy metal

Born in the Buffalo area on December 12, 1977, Williams first established himself as a musician. He was a founding member and rhythm guitarist of the metalcore band Every Time I Die, which formed in 1998.

The group went on to release nine studio albums and built a substantial following before announcing its breakup in January 2022.

Professional wrestling eventually became Williams ’ second major career. A lifelong fan of the sport, he began pursuing wrestling seriously later in life and worked his first full singles match in 2016.

He started regularly teaming with Jesse Guilmette the following year, with their partnership eventually taking them from the independent scene to national television.

Williams and The Blade joined All Elite Wrestling in 2019, initially appearing alongside The Bunny. The trio debuted on Dynamite by attacking Cody Rhodes , and The Butcher and The Blade subsequently became regulars in AEW’s tag-team division.

They worked with several notable names during their time with the promotion, including The Young Bucks, Eddie Kingston and members of the Hardy Family Office.

Williams also continued wrestling singles matches while The Blade dealt with a serious back injury. His final AEW appearance came in February 2025, when he faced Gabe Kidd on Collision. Their AEW contracts expired in June 2026, after which Williams returned to regular independent competition.

Only last month, Williams wrestled Josh Barnett at PRODUCE Volume 3 in Brooklyn. He had also continued working in music following Every Time I Die’s breakup, joining Atomic Rule and contributing to new recordings.

Williams ’ death is particularly poignant because he remained active in both wrestling and music right up until his final days. He had even shared a video on social media on Saturday showing progress on Atomic Rule’s latest recordings.

At 48, Williams leaves behind a distinctive legacy as both a professional wrestler and accomplished musician. His unexpected death during a wrestling match has shocked fans and colleagues, while his official cause of death remains pending.

articles.title: Female superstar Kelly Kelly hints at a return to WWE following 'Sunday Night's Main Event'
articles.standfirst: Kelly Kelly fuels comeback rumors with cryptic response
articles.summary: Kelly Kelly fuels comeback rumors with cryptic response
articles.body:
Former WWE Divas Champion Kelly Kelly has fueled speculation about a potential return to the promotion after an unexpected production error during Sunday Night’s Main Event in Atlanta, Georgia.

The September 6 show featured a stacked card, but an unusual moment during one of the night’s matches quickly became a talking point among wrestling fans.

Before the six-woman tag team bout, Tatum Paxley began making her way toward the ring when Kelly Kelly’s name and familiar entrance graphics unexpectedly appeared on the arena’s giant screen.

The mistake lasted only briefly before WWE’s production team corrected it and switched the display to Paxley’s intended entrance presentation.

Although the graphic disappeared quickly, viewers had already spotted the error, leading to immediate speculation about whether Kelly could be preparing for another WWE appearance.

Kelly herself appeared to find the situation amusing. The former champion shared a screenshot of the botched entrance on her Instagram Stories and directly addressed the possibility that the incident could have been more than a simple mistake.

“Well, someone hit the wrong button… should I take this as a hint?” she wrote.

Her response naturally added fuel to the rumors, although there’s currently no indication that WWE deliberately used her graphics as part of a planned return angle.

Kelly Kelly’s WWE journey and potential comeback

Kelly first joined WWE in 2006, initially appearing on the ECW brand. She later moved to Raw, where she established herself as one of the more recognizable performers in the company’s women’s division and began pursuing the Divas Championship.

Her biggest career achievement came in 2011 when she defeated Brie Bella on Raw to win the Divas Championship. Kelly enjoyed a reign lasting more than 100 days before eventually dropping the title.

She remained with WWE through 2012 before departing from her full-time role. However, her relationship with the company didn't completely end. Kelly returned for special appearances and matches over the following years, including the Women’s Royal Rumble in 2022.

That Royal Rumble appearance remains her most recent televised WWE match. She entered the 30-woman contest at No. 4 before being eliminated by Sasha Banks . The match was ultimately won by Ronda Rousey.

Kelly has also continued to have a connection with WWE through its Legends program. That makes another appearance possible, particularly if WWE decides to bring back a familiar name for a major event or storyline.

Fans shouldn't interpret the production mistake as confirmation of an imminent comeback. There was no announcement or storyline development during Sunday Night’s Main Event indicating that Kelly is returning to the active roster.

Paxley ultimately competed alongside Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss against Jade Cargill, Michin, and B-Fab , with Cargill’s team picking up the victory.

Kelly may have only appeared on the screen because someone selected the wrong entrance package, but her cheeky response has certainly given fans another reason to wonder whether the former Divas Champion could be ready to step back into a WWE ring.

articles.title: Logan Paul gets booed in Mexico City after bold Chivas move
articles.summary: Logan Paul was one of the most booed WWE stars during the company’s tour in Mexico City, but the reason may have had little to do with wrestling.
articles.body:
Logan Paul was one of the most booed WWE stars during the company’s tour in Mexico City, but the reason may have had little to do with wrestling.

Paul stepped into the ring wearing a Chivas de Guadalajara soccer jersey, a bold choice in a city where Club América has a massive following.

Chivas are América’s fierce rivals, and the decision to wear their colors immediately turned Paul into one of the biggest targets of the night.

Stirring controversy is one of the most effective techniques inside the ring, and Paul certainly knew how to command it to perfection.

articles.title: Hulk Hogan bought a mansion for $3.3 million in 2012: six months after his death, it went on the market for $11 million
articles.standfirst: A home of about 500 square meters near the Gulf of Mexico
articles.summary: A home of about 500 square meters near the Gulf of Mexico
articles.body:
A house can appreciate in value for many reasons, such as a renovation, its location, or the evolution of the real estate market itself. Proof of this is the mansion that Hulk Hogan bought in 2012 for $3.3 million and which, just six months after the former wrestler's death in 2025, had already increased in value to $11 million.

Located near the Gulf of Mexico, more specifically in the Clearwater Beach area , the mansion has around 500 square meters and features all the luxuries one would expect: five bedrooms, five bathrooms, an elevator, a heated pool, a spa, and large landscaped areas.

In 2012, Hulk Hogan was living in Tampa Bay in a mansion that he managed to sell for no less than $6.2 million in April of that year. With that money, he acquired the Clearwater Beach property, smaller than the previous one but which, in reality, afforded him certain luxuries such as having views of the Gulf of Mexico right in front of him.

All the details of Hulk Hogan's mansion

The property dates back to 2009 and is spread over three floors, blending Mediterranean and Italian style , and its façade already reveals an incredible double staircase, large windows, and a beautiful landscaped garden area . The interior finishes are marble and stone, and it also features a gas fireplace, a kitchen designed for use by a professional chef, and large open spaces.

The master bedroom alone measures about 93 square meters and is laid out into a living room, minibar, spa bathroom, and walk-in closet . All of this is accompanied by access to a terrace from which the gulf can be seen. Outside, in addition, there are about 140 square meters of covered area, where the pool and spa are located. In its first days on the market, it was listed for around 11 million dollars shortly after the death of the also actor, but local reports now place that sale price at about 7.9 million dollars .

articles.title: First MMA fight between a human and a "Terminator" robot: it has a "terrifying" ending
articles.standfirst: The debate over whether robots will eventually dominate humanity was put to the test with an MMA fight between an influencer and a Terminator
articles.summary: The debate over whether robots will eventually dominate humanity was put to the test with an MMA fight between an influencer and a Terminator
articles.body:
Influencer Frankie Lapenna , an American social media sensation with more than 3 million followers on Instagram, received a beating from a 1.80-meter-tall robot in an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) fight that was promoted as the first fight between a human and a robot .

'The Rekbot" from Rek Robotics , which s resembles a T-800 from the "Terminator" film franchise , and the influencer locked themselves in a cage to fight in the "Human vs Terminator" bout (Human against Terminator) .'

"I'm scared for you" , a man told Lapenna before fighting the robot.

Lapenna managed to land several blows on the robot, but the "Rekbot" ended up knocking down the influencer with a flying kick.

The famous influencer, who ended up bruised and sore , collapsed onto the canvas and could not get back to his feet.

Social media reactions to the first fight between a human and a robot

The fight had a huge following on social media, and prompted comments such as "fuck the UFC, I want to see more of this", "where did this person get the courage? I would be scared", "a preview of the first episode of Black Mirror season eight", "this is terrifying" or "humans are screwed".

Benjamin Satterley passed away after fighting Andrade "The Idol"

On the night of Saturday, September 26, it was the last public appearance of Benjamin Satterley , who stepped down from the ring after facing the Mexican gladiator Andrade "El Ídolo" , and on Sunday afternoon AEW announced his passing in a statement it shared on its social media:

" All Elite Wrestling is saddened to announce the passing of Benjamin Satterley, known as Pac . Born in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. Pac signed with All Elite Wrestling in 2019 and held multiple AEW Championships. Our condolences go out to Satterley’s family, friends, and fans.

His last match was a battle for the AEW national title against Mexican wrestler Andrade "El Ídolo ", a match he lost, which was also one of the main-event fights of All Out 2026 by All Elite Wrestling, an event that took place at NOW Arena, in Illinois.

articles.title: John Cena reveals how much he misses WWE after retiring less than a year ago
articles.standfirst: Cena says he misses performing in front of WWE fans but knows retirement was the right choice
articles.summary: Cena says he misses performing in front of WWE fans but knows retirement was the right choice
articles.body:
John Cena may have walked away from WWE , but the former world champion admits the emotional distance hasn't been nearly as easy as the physical one.

Less than a year after ending his in-ring career, Cena says he still misses almost everything about wrestling, from the roar of the crowd to the feeling of performing live.

Speaking to People at the New York City premiere of Matchbox: The Movie on October 5, the 49-year-old star revealed that nostalgia has become a regular part of his life.

“I have moments of nostalgic reflection on the daily. A lot of times, that’s when you’re overwhelmed by stress or confused or maybe you don’t know the answers that you’re trying to seek,” said Cena .

“Nostalgia is in itself looking back to a simpler time in the unknown or during crisis. I got daily moments of that, man. Daily.

“I’ll look back on my early wrestling days, or I’ll look back on college days, or I’ll look back on my life in dormitory school, or even as a kid. That happens on the daily, man.”

Cena officially retired from WWE in December 2025 following an extraordinary 24-year career. During that time, he became one of the company's most recognizable performers and captured a record 17 world championships.

His final full-time run also included some major career moments, including a surprising heel turn and another world title victory in 2025.

Despite how much he misses the business, however, Cena isn't planning a return to competition. He explained that his heart still longs for wrestling, but his mind understands that stepping away was the right decision.

Cena's second act is taking shape

Retirement has also given Cena the opportunity to focus more completely on a Hollywood career that once looked far less certain. The actor recently opened up about the difficulties he experienced early in his movie career, admitting that he wasn't always as invested in filmmaking as he should've been.

Cena explained that wrestling consumed his attention as a young performer. He loved traveling around the world, appearing in front of huge crowds and performing night after night.

Compared with that environment, movie production seemed slow and unfamiliar, something he didn't have the maturity to fully appreciate at the time.

"I got [run] out of the movie business for not caring, and that's justifiably so. If you don't care about something, give somebody the opportunity that does,” said Cena .

His perspective has changed considerably. Cena now says he's grateful for the second chance Hollywood gave him and believes it took years of personal growth to understand what the opportunity meant. That evolution has helped him establish himself as a major screen performer, with credits including Barbie, Fast X and The Suicide Squad.

Although Cena's competitive wrestling days are over, his relationship with WWE isn't disappearing. Before retiring, he said he hoped to remain connected to the WWE family and contribute in a mentor role.

He also returned to the company after his retirement to host WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas, demonstrating that leaving the ring doesn't mean completely leaving the organization behind.

While Cena may miss the ring every day, his comments suggest he's at peace with the decision to move forward. His wrestling career may be finished, but his next chapter is already well underway.

articles.title: A wrestler kills a referee in the ring after applying a prohibited hold: the neckbreaker
articles.standfirst: Mexican wrestler Hijo de Fishman was arrested after causing the death of referee Gerardo Germán Pineda during a match in Mexico
articles.summary: Mexican wrestler Hijo de Fishman was arrested after causing the death of referee Gerardo Germán Pineda during a match in Mexico
articles.body:
The Mexican wrestler Hijo de Fishman was arrested after throwing referee Gerardo Germán Pineda into the ring and then delivering a "piledriver" (also known as a martinete or neckbraker), a move banned due to its high danger.

"Telemundo" reported that the 75-year-old referee, who in his wrestling days was known as El Búho , died in the ring .

'An eyewitness claims that Hijo de Fishman and the referee argued before the fatal incident, which took place at the Centro Deportivo Cultural 11 de Julio , in Mineral de la Reforma (Mexico) during an event called "Disloyalties" .'

Hijo de Fishman, who is a second-generation wrestler ( he is the son of José Ángel Nájera Sánchez ), was taking part in the main event against Máscara Sagrada NG.

Municipal police officers detained him and handed him over to the Attorney General's Office of the State of Hidalgo , which could charge the wrestler with negligent homicide.

articles.title: Who is Fishman's Son? The wrestler detained after the death of referee “El Búho”
articles.standfirst: The wrestler has been detained following the tragedy at an event in Pachuca
articles.summary: The wrestler has been detained following the tragedy at an event in Pachuca
articles.body:
Professional wrestling is going through a difficult time in our country after a tragedy occurred at the Centro Deportivo Cultural 11 de julio de Mineral de Reforma, Municipality of Hidalgo , when the referee known as “El Búho” lost his life in the ring after Hijo de Fishman performed a piledriver on him, a move prohibited in this sport because of the risks it can cause to whoever receives this punishment.

October 6, 2026, has been a day of mourning for Mexican wrestling and will mark a before and after in the history of this sport with the death, in the middle of the show, of “El Búho” , who received a banned hold from the Hijo de Fishman , who is now under arrest for the referee’s death.

Who is Hijo de Fishman? Wrestler detained over the referee's death

The name of Fishman's Son is linked to one of the families with the greatest tradition in Mexican wrestling, as he is the son of José Ángel Nájera Sánchez, Fishman , that legendary wrestler who during the seventies and eighties became one of the great icons of Mexican wrestling under the character of the “Green Venom”

The son of Fishman decided to follow in his father's footsteps and made his professional debut on November 22, 2008, in Xalapa, Veracruz . Since then, he has built his own story mainly on the independent circuit, where he has had the opportunity to perform both in Mexico and at international events.

Among his most important moments are the championships he won in Continental Wrestling Federation (CWF) and Furia de Titanes , in addition to several wager matches that ended with the masks of Cuchillo Jr. and Scrash falling, as well as the hair of Éxtasis .

Profile of Fishman's son:

He debuted on November 22, 2008 in Xalapa, Veracruz

He is the son of Fishman, one of the great figures of Mexican professional wrestling

Among his achievements are CWF championships and Fury of the Titans

He has won the masks of Cuchillo Jr. and Scrash and the hair of Éxtasis

Fishman's Son is arrested after the death of referee “El Búho”

On social media, the moment in which Fishman's Son performs a piledriver on referee "El Búho" has gone viral; he is left unconscious in the ring, so medical services intervene immediately, but they are unsuccessful and he dies inside the ring.

After this tragedy, the Son of Fishman , identified as José Angel N., was detained by municipal security officers and placed at the disposal of the Public Prosecutor's Office , so the pertinent investigations are already being carried out to clarify the facts and determine the future of the wrestler, who could be convicted of involuntary manslaughter.

articles.title: Who was 'El Búho'? The referee who died after a blow from Hijo de Fishman
articles.standfirst: Gerardo Germán Pineda was a renowned wrestler for more than 15 years and was involved in this sport for three decades
articles.summary: Gerardo Germán Pineda was a renowned wrestler for more than 15 years and was involved in this sport for three decades
articles.body:
Gerardo Germán Pineda, known in wrestling as "El Búho," died at the age of 75. His journey in professional wrestling began approximately three decades ago; however, he devoted half of that career to refereeing, the profession in which he unfortunately lost his life. His death occurred after suffering a fatal blow from Hijo de Fishman during an event held in Mineral de la Reforma.

Pineda, a gladiator widely recognized throughout the Mexican Republic and very popular in the state of Hidalgo, began his journey in the ring three decades ago, driven by the influence of his brother. His life came to an end in the ring, although in his final stage he did so by officiating. Unfortunately, a punishment in the form of a "piledriver" executed by Hijo de Fishman sent him to the canvas, an action that ultimately proved fatal. After the death of "El Búho" was confirmed, the rough-style wrestler was detained by the authorities and remains awaiting the determination of his legal status.

Before becoming the highest authority in the ring, Pineda adopted the name "El Búho Negro II" in honor of his brother ("El Búho Negro I"). During his time as an active wrestler, which lasted 15 years, he suffered more than 30 stitches to the head, according to what he later admitted. “I owe professional wrestling to my brother, may he rest in peace,” the referee himself had said in an interview given to the local outlet Criterio Hidalgo in January 2026.

After the loss of his brother, Pineda considered stepping away from the ring before fortuitously transitioning into refereeing after the official referee was absent from an event he was attending. His debut as a ring official came spontaneously when he was asked to fill the vacancy with the phrase: “The referee didn’t show up and they told me: ‘get in there and referee’.”

His start as the judge of the contest did not represent unfamiliar ground for Pineda, who knew how to make the most of his extensive background as an active wrestler to perfectly understand the psychology of the gladiators in the ring. This previous experience allowed him to accurately anticipate every movement within the discipline.

"The Owl" consolidated the bulk of his career as a referee in the emblematic Arena Afición of Pachuca, a venue that became one of the favorite settings of his career. It was there that he established himself on the region’s most important cards, even sharing the ring and officiating matches headlined by the biggest figures in national professional wrestling.

Every time he was asked about his first night at the traditional Arena Afición in Pachuca, the experienced referee humbly recalled the nervousness of that evening: “I was sweating, it was my first time at that level; I veered off a little, but I got back on track.” That debut would mark the beginning of a close relationship with the fans of Hidalgo.

The public, his great ally

Before the fateful incident with Hijo de Fishman, "El Búho" had already been involved in other episodes in which he came close to tragedy. One of the most remembered occurred in Pachuca during the 2022 season, when he suffered a spectacular headfirst fall in an event headlined by Penta El Zero M and Fénix. On that occasion, with the chivalry that characterized him, the referee absolved the wrestlers of all responsibility: “I slipped and fell on my head; it felt awful, but it wasn’t their fault.”

In a previous interview with Criterio Hidalgo, the wrestling referee acknowledged that one of the most rewarding moments of his career was the affection of the public outside the venues. “It feels nice to be walking down the street and have people ask you for a photo,” he confessed about the fans’ affection.

'As if foreshadowing his own fate, Pineda, who ensures his sporting legacy through the continuity of his son "El Búho Jr.," left a phrase for posterity that today echoes powerfully in the national wrestling scene: “Professional wrestling, I owe you nothing and you owe me nothing. Thank you, blessed sport of professional wrestling.”'
